title: Sunflow unit profile
description: Units below a device that Home Assistant shows as devices of their own (module optimizers, battery modules) and the entities of their values. Files under profiles/units/.

name.description: Name of the source in the UI (e.g. the manufacturer).

url.description: Where to get the integration, if it is no core integration.

sub_device.description: Units are sub-devices of another device (e.g. the inverter).

exclude_identifier.description: Devices with this text in an identifier are no unit (e.g. sums over a string).

name_strip.description: Prefix removed from the device name.

label_position.description: Optimizers: regular expression on the label whose two groups give string letter and module number ("A1": string A, module 1).

required.description: Values a device must have to count as unit.

value.description: End of the entity's unique_id, matched like role keys ('_' or '-' before it, wildcards allowed). Several matches: the shortest unique_id; with aggregate the max, min or mean of all.

ok.description: Status values (alarm, protection, fault): states meaning no problem; any other state is shown as problem. Without it 0 means no problem.
